topics.label: Introduction and Learning Outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic introduces the lecture by outlining its key learning objectives and connecting them to practical histopathology observations.

topics.label: Tumor Virology and Experimental Assays of Cell Transformation
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine how the study of tumor viruses led to the discovery of cellular proto-oncogenes and established laboratory assays for cellular transformation.

topics.label: Classification and Mechanisms of Oncogenes and Tumor Suppressors
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics define the functional classifications of cancer-associated mutations and illustrate their mechanistic consequences using cell cycle regulatory genes.

topics.label: Mechanisms of Genetic Instability and Multi-Step Progression
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the repair failures and mitotic errors that generate genomic instability to accelerate stepwise tumor progression.

topics.label: Hereditary Cancer Predisposition and Tumor Evolution
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explore inherited germline mutations in cancer predisposition syndromes and their influence on tumor development and evolution.

topics.label: Lecture Wrap-Up and Recommended Reading
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic concludes the lecture with an invitation for questions, recommendations for further reading, and a preview of the next session.
